envs.name: FEAT_URL
envs.description: feat host base URL — enables the loader's remote resolution (features are fetched from here at boot)

envs.name: FEAT_GET_UPDATES_SLOT
envs.description: slot toggle: which slot the feature fills; 'route' is the built-in HTTP-endpoint slot

envs.name: FEAT_GET_UPDATES_MOUNT
envs.description: optional route-path override; 'true' or absent = defaultMount /get-updates

envs.name: FEAT_GET_UPDATES_FEATURES
envs.description: override the reported features list (comma-separated ids)

envs.name: TAG_VERSION
envs.description: deploy identity: app version (falls back to package.json version)
